title: A binary save format

solution.solution.lua:
local function fnv1a(text)
    local hash = 0x811C9DC5
    for i = 1, #text do
        hash = ((hash ~ text:byte(i)) * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    end
    return hash
end

function save(player)
    local parts = { string.pack("<c4 B s1 I2 d B", "XSAV", 1, player.name, player.level, player.health, #player.items) }
    for _, item in ipairs(player.items) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = string.pack("<s1", item)
    end
    local body = table.concat(parts)
    return body .. string.pack("<I4", fnv1a(body))
end

function load_save(data)
    if #data < 5 then return nil, "truncated" end
    if data:sub(1, 4) ~= "XSAV" then return nil, "not a save file" end
    local version = data:byte(5)
    if version ~= 1 then return nil, "unsupported version " .. version end
    if #data < 9 then return nil, "truncated" end
    local body = data:sub(1, -5)
    if string.unpack("<I4", data, #data - 3) ~= fnv1a(body) then return nil, "damaged file" end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local name, level, health, count, pos = string.unpack("<s1 I2 d B", body, 6)
        local items = {}
        for i = 1, count do
            items[i], pos = string.unpack("<s1", body, pos)
        end
        return { name = name, level = level, health = health, items = items }
    end)
    if not ok then return nil, "truncated" end
    return result
end

hints: `string.pack("<c4 B s1 I2 d B", ...)` packs all the fixed fields in one call (`c4` is exactly 4 characters); the items follow, one `s1` each. Compute the checksum over the joined body and pack it last.
Check in the order a reader can: magic, version, checksum, and only then unpack the rest, passing the position each `string.unpack` returns to the next one.
unitTests:
local player = { name = "Ada", level = 7, health = 82.5, items = { "sword", "key" } }

test("round trip", function()
    local data = save(player)
    check_eq(data:sub(1, 4), "XSAV")
    check_eq(#data, 4 + 1 + 4 + 2 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 4)
    check_eq(load_save(data), player)
    local empty = { name = "", level = 0, health = 0.0, items = {} }
    check_eq(load_save(save(empty)), empty)
end)

test("bad files", function()
    local data = save(player)
    local function changed(pos, byte) return data:sub(1, pos - 1) .. string.char(byte) .. data:sub(pos + 1) end
    check_eq(select(2, load_save("YSAV" .. data:sub(5))), "not a save file")
    check_eq(select(2, load_save(changed(5, 2))), "unsupported version 2")
    check_eq(select(2, load_save(changed(10, data:byte(10) ~ 1))), "damaged file")
    check_eq(select(2, load_save("XS")), "truncated")
end)
